# Modal

A focused dialog for messages, confirmations, and short tasks that need the user's attention. Composed of a header (featured icon + close), a body (title + description + optional swap content), and an actions row. Supports desktop (600px) and mobile (320px) widths, leading/center title alignment, inline or stacked actions, and full RTL. Modeled on Figma frames 30150:55001 (Modal), 30150:55018 (Header), 30150:55083 (Body), 30150:55043 (Actions), 30150:55096 (Swap placeholder).

**Stylesheet:** `components/modal/modal.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/modal.js` (classes `ModalManager`); wired through `[data-modal-open]`, `[data-modal-close]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes and JS hooks for composing and controlling modals.

| Class / Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.modal-backdrop` | CSS class | Fixed full-screen overlay that centers the modal and dims the page. Add .is-open to show it. |
| `.modal` | CSS class | The dialog container. White bg, 8px radius, shadow-3xl, 24px padding. 600px wide by default. |
| `.modal--mobile` | Modifier | Narrows the dialog to 320px (mobile layout). |
| `.modal--center` | Modifier | Centers the featured icon and title. |
| .modal-header / .modal-header__top | Slot | Header stack: the top row holds the featured icon (leading) and close button (trailing); the title sits below. |
| `.modal-icon` | Slot | Circular featured icon (40px). Holds an icon-font glyph. |
| `.modal-close` | Slot | Close (X) button. Pair with data-modal-close to wire dismissal. |
| `.modal-title` | Slot | Title — 18/28 semibold, text-display #1F2A37. |
| .modal-body / .modal-description | Slot | Body wrapper + description copy — 14/20 regular, text-primary-paragraph #384250. |
| `.modal-custom` | Slot | Dashed primary swap-content placeholder for composing custom modal content. |
| `.modal-actions` | Slot | Action row. Inline + trailing-aligned by default. |
| `.modal-actions--stack` | Modifier | Stacks the buttons vertically, full-width (mobile pattern). |
| `.modal-actions--fill` | Modifier | Each button stretches to fill the row equally. |
| `data-modal-open="ID"` | JS hook | On any trigger element — opens the .modal-backdrop with that id. |
| `data-modal-close` | JS hook | On any element inside a backdrop — closes the modal. Backdrop click and ESC also close. |

## Anatomy

A complete modal: header (featured icon + close), body (title + description), and an actions row with a secondary and a primary button.

```html
<div class="modal">
    <div class="modal-header">
        <div class="modal-header__top">
            <span class="modal-icon"><span class="dga-icon-information-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <button type="button" class="modal-close" aria-label="Close"><span class="dga-icon-cancel-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
        </div>
        <h3 class="modal-title">Title goes here</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
        <p class="modal-description">When a Modal needs a further detailed explanation, it goes here.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline"><span class="icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M3 8h10M9 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
                </svg></span>Button</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary"><span class="icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M3 8h10M9 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
                </svg></span>Button</button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Action Layouts

Actions sit inline and trailing-aligned on desktop (1, 2, or 3 buttons) and stack full-width on mobile. The last button is the primary action.

```html
<div class="modal" style="box-shadow: none; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-secondary);">
    <div class="modal-header">
        <h3 class="modal-title">Single primary action</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
        <p class="modal-description">A confirmation with one call to action.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-primary">Confirm</button>
    </div>
</div>


<div class="modal" style="box-shadow: none; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-secondary);">
    <div class="modal-header">
        <h3 class="modal-title">Secondary + primary</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
        <p class="modal-description">The most common pairing — cancel and confirm.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary">Confirm</button>
    </div>
</div>


<div class="modal modal--mobile" style="box-shadow: none; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-secondary);">
    <div class="modal-header">
        <h3 class="modal-title">Stacked actions</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
        <p class="modal-description">On mobile, actions stack full-width with the primary on top.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-actions modal-actions--stack">
        <button class="btn btn-primary">Primary</button>
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Secondary</button>
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Tertiary</button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Swap Content Body

The body can host any custom component via the .modal-custom swap slot (Figma 30150:55096) — a form, a table, an illustration, etc.

```html
<div class="modal">
    <div class="modal-header">
        <div class="modal-header__top">
            <span class="modal-icon"><span class="dga-icon-information-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <button type="button" class="modal-close" aria-label="Close"><span class="dga-icon-cancel-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
        </div>
        <h3 class="modal-title">Title goes here</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
        <p class="modal-description">When a Modal needs a further detailed explanation, it goes here.</p>
        <div class="modal-custom">
            <h4 class="modal-custom__title">Swap with content component</h4>
            <p class="modal-custom__body">Replace this slot with any component</p>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary">Confirm</button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Open as Overlay

The real behavior: a trigger opens the modal over a dimmed backdrop. Click the backdrop, the close button, or press Esc to dismiss.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary" data-modal-open="demo-overlay-modal">Open modal</button>

<div class="modal-backdrop" id="demo-overlay-modal">
    <div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="demo-overlay-title">
        <div class="modal-header">
            <div class="modal-header__top">
                <span class="modal-icon"><span class="dga-icon-information-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
                <button type="button" class="modal-close" aria-label="Close" data-modal-close=""><span class="dga-icon-cancel-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
            </div>
            <h3 class="modal-title" id="demo-overlay-title">Confirm your action</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body">
            <p class="modal-description">This modal is rendered over a real backdrop. Click outside, press
                Esc, or use a button to close it.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-actions">
            <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline" data-modal-close="">Cancel</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" data-modal-close="">Confirm</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## RTL Support

Arabic and other right-to-left layouts mirror the modal: the featured icon moves to the trailing (right) edge, the close button to the left, and the title + actions align from the right.

```html
<div class="modal modal--rtl" dir="rtl">
    <div class="modal-header">
        <div class="modal-header__top">
            <span class="modal-icon"><span class="dga-icon-information-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <button type="button" class="modal-close" aria-label="إغلاق"><span class="dga-icon-cancel-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
        </div>
        <h3 class="modal-title">عنوان الرسالة يُكتب هنا</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
        <p class="modal-description">يُكتب المحتوى الإضافي هنا في حال أن رسالة الإشعار أو التنبيه تحتاج إلى شرح
            أو تفصيل.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">إجراء</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary">إجراء</button>
    </div>
</div>
```
